description: Clean input with a flat line-level fee and no parent MAP. Acquisition cost and units per package are both clean numbers. Should produce correct unit_cost, null map_per_unit, and correct wholesale_price with no anomaly flags.
Standard VPD scenario with a percentage fee and a parent MAP price. Should derive map_per_unit correctly, apply the 12% fee to unit_cost, and flag no anomalies since fee is within threshold.

Fee value is 30%, which exceeds the 25% anomaly threshold. Calculator should compute correctly AND return a populated anomaly_flags array identifying the over-threshold fee. Tests whether the model can calculate and flag simultaneously.

fee_type is provided but fee_value is null. Model must not fabricate a fee value. Should return a clear error identifying the missing field and return null for fee_applied, wholesale_price, and price_at_quantities. unit_cost and map_per_unit should still be calculated from the available data.
